expectedRealization.rationale: China restocking/export recovery and mine-volume growth should enter one to two reporting cycles while copper pricing remains supportive.

acceptableExpressionSet.rationale: Direct gold/copper mining exposure, realized Q3 profit/cash conversion and multi-year mine-volume growth provide a sound expression without requiring peer-best performance.

Direct copper exposure and a contemporaneous 19-35% earnings uplift bridge from higher copper forecasts make Jiangxi Copper a valid opportunity expression even though trailing 9M profit remained down.

changeHypothesis.summary: China manufacturing/export recovery and rising raw-material prices confirmed an early industrial-metals upcycle. 紫金 had already converted higher volumes/prices into profit and cash flow while a substantial multi-year copper mine ramp was underway; 江西铜业 provided a second direct copper expression with a quantitative earnings bridge from higher copper forecasts.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: The demand recovery is multi-quarter, and 紫金's earnings path is supported by mine-volume additions rather than spot prices alone.
disconfirmingEvidence: All three frozen metals names had already rallied strongly over 20d and 60d.
江西铜业 trailing profit had not yet fully recovered.

causalChain.mechanism: Restocking and stronger production/new orders raise industrial metal demand.
causalChain.failureMode: global recovery stalls or inventories surge

causalChain.mechanism: Higher realized prices and greater mine output expand mining margin and cash generation; smelter/integrated expressions benefit with different sensitivity.
causalChain.failureMode: metal prices reverse or mine ramp slips

causalChain.mechanism: The opportunity can work through more than one acceptable producer; exact peer ranking is secondary if each expression has direct exposure and adequate path room.
causalChain.failureMode: the rally fully capitalizes both price and volume before earnings revisions arrive

directWinners: integrated copper producers with direct copper exposure
losers: downstream manufacturers unable to pass through raw-material inflation
substitutes: aluminum and other conductive materials in selected applications
falseThemeMatches: metal-related companies without material upstream or price-sensitive earnings

selectedDisadvantages: Tongling could offer cheaper beta to copper if smelting economics improve

selectionComparison.rationale: The opportunity has more than one acceptable copper/mining expression; 紫金 is preferred for evidence quality, not because the Skill requires it to outperform every peer.

expectations.marketExpectationAtCutoff: The sector had already rallied sharply: the frozen basket beat CSI300 by ~28pp over both 20d and 60d. 紫金's Oct27 forecast nevertheless implied a falling forward PE path as profits rose from RMB6.5bn to RMB13.2bn by 2022.
expectations.thesisExpectation: The Nov manufacturing/export data and stronger copper backdrop raise the probability that price assumptions are conservative while already-funded mine-volume growth lifts later earnings.
expectations.measurableGap: The key gap is not 'copper goes up'; it is that a price-supportive macro recovery coincides with an independently visible multi-year volume ramp, improving the whole path without needing perpetual commodity inflation.

expectationBurdenTest.valuationMethod: Multi-year forward earnings path plus commodity/volume decomposition.
expectationBurdenTest.marketBaseline: Oct27 forecast: 2020/21/22 profit RMB6.505/9.131/13.238bn and PE about 27x/19x/13x before the late-Nov price move.
expectationBurdenTest.thesisScenario: Stronger-than-frozen copper demand/price plus mine ramp lifts 2021-22 earnings above the contemporaneous baseline.
expectationBurdenTest.breakevenCondition: At least the 2021/22 path must improve enough to offset part of the already-large Q4 equity rerating; spot copper alone is insufficient.
expectationBurdenTest.ordinaryScenarioFailure: Copper holds but only confirms the existing forecast while the equity multiple compresses after its rapid rally.
expectationBurdenTest.catalystOrTimingBridge: Q4/2021Q1 realized metal prices, mine production and updated profit forecasts are inside the 60d base window.

fundamentalAcceleration.rationale: PMI/new orders/export orders and copper-market evidence strengthened while 紫金's volume/profit/cash conversion was already visible.

realizedCompanyConfirmation.rationale: 紫金 9M revenue/profit/CFO already accelerated; 江西 has a quantitative copper-price revision bridge.

crossSectionalConfirmation.rationale: The broader metals basket was strong, but earnings quality differed; not all names had equally strong conversion.

baselineLag.rationale: The Oct27 紫金 forecast predates the late-Nov PMI confirmation and stronger copper-recovery evidence.

priceAbsorption.checkMethod: Use the frozen 20/60d strong regime together with forward 2021/22 earnings path rather than point momentum alone.

priceRegime.method: equal-weight frozen industrial-metals basket versus CSI300 using hfq history

fundamentalImpulse.rationale: Manufacturing/new orders/export orders and raw-material input prices were all strengthening.

earningsRevisionBreadth.rationale: Copper/mining expressions have strong revision potential while aluminum and lower-upstream controls remain less clean.

eventHalfLife.rationale: The post-pandemic restocking/industrial recovery and mine ramp extend beyond a one-month commodity spike.

lateCycleRisk.rationale: Prices have rallied sharply, but this is an early economic-recovery phase and the later earnings path includes physical mine-volume growth rather than a mature cycle peak.

opportunityTimingTest.rationale: Price, macro fundamentals and producer earnings paths are aligned, though prior rerating raises entry risk.

qualityFloor.rationale: Strong profit growth and operating cash conversion clear quality.

revisionHeadroom.rationale: Late-Nov demand evidence can lift already-growing 2021-22 earnings from both price and volume.

valuationSlack.rationale: The published path compressed PE materially into 2022, leaving room if later earnings rise above baseline despite the Q4 rally.

catalystReachability.rationale: Q4 metal prices, mine production and early-2021 forecasts are observable inside 60 trading days.

downsideContainment.rationale: Mine-volume growth and positive cash flow reduce dependence on continued multiple expansion, though commodity reversal remains a risk.

pairwise.revisionAdvantage: 紫金 already converts the cycle into profit/CFO; Chalco still has weak trailing profit.
pairwise.valuationAdvantage: 紫金 forward path falls toward a low-teens 2022 PE if projects execute.
pairwise.qualityTradeoff: 紫金 quality is stronger; Chalco offers turnaround beta.
pairwise.catalystAdvantage: Mine ramps plus metal prices give 紫金 two independent catalysts.
pairwise.downsideTradeoff: Chalco could rebound more if spreads normalize but has weaker current earnings protection.
pairwise.switchCondition: Switch if Chalco demonstrates a clear margin/profit inflection with similar path room.

pairwise.revisionAdvantage: 紫金 has a clearer multi-year upstream production ramp.
pairwise.valuationAdvantage: Tongling may be cheaper but has less frozen path differentiation.
pairwise.qualityTradeoff: Both are viable copper-cycle expressions; 紫金 has stronger upstream self-sufficiency and cash evidence.
pairwise.catalystAdvantage: 紫金's mine ramp is additional to copper price.
pairwise.downsideTradeoff: Tongling's integrated model can be more defensive to selected price moves but less torqued to mining margin.
pairwise.switchCondition: Switch if Tongling's upstream contribution/earnings revisions become clearly superior.

earningsConversionBridge.driverChange: Gold/copper sales volumes had already risen and major copper projects were ramping while the demand/price backdrop improved.
earningsConversionBridge.earningsMechanism: Higher mine volumes plus supportive metal prices lift mining gross profit and operating cash flow; this was already visible in 9M results.
earningsConversionBridge.nextObservableMetric: Q4/2021Q1 mine output, realized copper/gold prices, profit and operating cash flow
earningsConversionBridge.failureCondition: Mine ramp stalls or metal-price reversal causes 2021/22 profit forecasts to fail to improve.

baselinePath.nextPeriod: 2021 profit RMB9.131bn as copper/gold volumes and prices improve.
baselinePath.laterPeriod: 2022 profit RMB13.238bn with copper mine output ramping further.
baselinePath.rationale: The Oct27 path already embeds substantial project growth and moderate metal-price assumptions.

thesisPath.nearTermChange: Late-Nov manufacturing/export strength supports stronger Q4 realized metal prices and demand.
thesisPath.nextPeriodChange: Copper demand/price assumptions can be revised higher while physical mine ramp is already funded and visible.
thesisPath.laterPeriodChange: Later earnings retain volume-driven growth even if commodity prices merely stay around the frozen assumptions, reducing reliance on perpetual price acceleration.
thesisPath.mechanism: A simultaneous price-demand recovery and producer-specific mine-volume ramp improve the full path rather than only the current quarter.

incrementalPathAdvantage.rationale: New demand evidence supports higher price realization while the producer-specific volume path supplies an independent later-period earnings engine.

durationRisk.rationale: Commodity prices are cyclical and the stock has rerated, but the thesis does not require peak copper prices to persist because mine-volume expansion supports later earnings.

expectationPathTest.falsifier: 2021-22 earnings forecasts fail to rise or mine-volume milestones slip despite the stronger industrial-demand backdrop.

valuationExecution.valuationContext: High-priority opportunity with two acceptable expressions; peer-best precision is secondary to preserving direct exposure and path discipline.
valuationExecution.alreadyPricedAssessment: material rerating but not fully exhausted if 2021-22 path improves

bearCase: The Q4 metal rally is mostly a liquidity/reopening trade; copper demand normalizes before mine-volume gains can offset multiple compression.
